meta.description: Quinn Doak, Student SOC Analyst at Old Dominion University. Security+ certified, working in CrowdStrike, QRadar, and Entra ID. Seeking SOC and GRC internships. U.S. citizen, eligible for Secret clearance.

hero.name: Quinn Doak
hero.targetLine: Cybersecurity student at ODU building SOC and GRC skills for the defense sector. Security+ certified.
hero.supporting: Analyst in the ODU Student SOC and writer on security policy. Graduating December 2027.

paragraphs: B.S. Cybersecurity with a Political Science minor at ODU. I like the overlap between technical controls and the policy that decides which ones matter, which is why I chase both SOC and GRC work.

Right now I spend my shifts in the ODU Student SOC triaging phishing, investigating risky sign-ins, and chasing endpoint alerts. Years of customer-facing leadership and live sound work taught me to stay steady when something goes wrong in real time, which is most of what a SOC shift is.
I am looking for SOC and GRC internships and entry-level roles in the Hampton Roads defense community, graduating December 2027. U.S. citizen, eligible for Secret clearance.

callout.heading: Hiring for a SOC or GRC role?
callout.subline: Open to internships and entry-level roles in Hampton Roads or remote.
